items.source: Note that unlike slice(int, int), this method will call DataBufferUtils.retain(DataBuffer) (or equivalent) on the resulting slice.
items.translation: 注意，与slice(int, int)不同，此方法 将对生成的切片调用 DataBufferUtils.retain(DataBuffer) （或等效操作）。

items.source: The read and write position of the returned buffer are truncated to fit within the buffers capacity if necessary. The positions of this buffer are set to 0 if they are smaller than index.
items.translation: 返回缓冲区的read和write位置在必要时会被截断以适配缓冲区的capacity。如果这些位置小于index，则它们将被设置为0。

items.source: The main purpose of the DataBuffer abstraction is to provide a convenient wrapper around ByteBuffer which is similar to Netty's ByteBuf but can also be used on non-Netty platforms (i.e. Servlet containers).
items.translation: `DataBuffer` 抽象的主要目的是提供一个方便的包装器，封装与 ByteBuffer（类似于 Netty 的ByteBuf），但也可用于非 Netty 平台（即 Servlet 容器）。

items.source: Data that precedes the index will be returned in a new buffer, while this buffer will contain data that follows after index. Memory between the two buffers is shared, but independent and cannot overlap (unlike slice).
items.translation: 位于 `index` 之前的数据将返回到一个新缓冲区中，而该缓冲区则包含 `index` 之后的数据。两个缓冲区之间的内存是共享的，但彼此独立且不能重叠（与 slice 不同）。

items.source: The capacity of a DataBuffer is expanded on demand, similar to StringBuilder.
items.translation: `DataBuffer` 的容量会按需扩展，类似于 `StringBuilder`。

items.source: Note that the returned iterator must be used in a try-with-resources clause or explicitly closed.
items.translation: 注意，返回的迭代器必须在 try-with-resources 语句中使用，或显式地关闭。

items.source: Returns a ByteBuffer representation of this data buffer. Data between this DataBuffer and the returned ByteBuffer is not shared.

items.source: Expose this buffer's data as an InputStream. Both data and read position are shared between the returned stream and this data buffer. The underlying buffer will not be released when the input stream is closed.
